_comment: Scenario puzzles (timed, single-trip conditions or stat gains) and training missions (no time limit). trip conditions: good, minQty, maxFuel (fuel credits), minProfit, toRole (consumer|producer), minDistance, maxHours. stat: a stat that must rise by gain.

puzzles.name: Lean Burn
puzzles.text: Deliver at least 100 units on a trip that spends no more than 100 credits of fuel.

puzzles.name: Grain Relief
puzzles.text: Deliver 200+ grain to a port that consumes grain within 36 hours.

puzzles.name: Express Run
puzzles.text: Complete a profitable delivery whose voyage took 6 hours or less.

puzzles.name: Long Haul
puzzles.text: Deliver cargo over a distance of 300+ and still turn a 500-credit profit.

puzzles.name: Precision Freight
puzzles.text: Make 1,000+ profit on a single machinery delivery within 48 hours.

puzzles.name: Training: Buy Low, Sell High
puzzles.text: Complete any delivery that makes a profit.

puzzles.name: Training: Feed the Market
puzzles.text: Deliver any cargo to a port that consumes it.

puzzles.name: Training: Chart the Coast
puzzles.text: Dock at two ports you have not visited before.

puzzles.name: Training: Full Holds
puzzles.text: Land 400 units of cargo in total.

tutorial.name: Cast off
tutorial.text: Load a cargo at a port that produces it and sail to another port.

tutorial.name: First sale
tutorial.text: Sell the cargo at your destination.

tutorial.name: Mind the margin
tutorial.text: Earn 500 credits of trip profit in total.
